data.title: Dow Analysts Increase Their Forecasts Following Better-Than-Expected Q3 Earnings
data.description: Dow beat Q3 earnings and revenue estimates, forecast $1.5B Q4 EBITDA, and saw analysts raise price targets; shares rose 3.3%.

data.title: Palmer Luckey's New Defense Startup Is Cloning War Dogs
data.description: Palmer Luckey and Ben Lamm launch Warhound with $200M to genetically engineer military dogs for U.S. defense and first responders.

data.title: These Analysts Revise Their Forecasts On Union Pacific After Q3 Results
data.description: Union Pacific beat Q3 estimates with EPS up 15% and revenue up 15%, reaffirmed 2026 growth outlook, and raised capital spending to $3.5B.

data.title: Elon Musk Says Ukraine's Elites Profit From War as Starlink Restrictions Disrupt Ukrainian Drones
data.description: Elon Musk accused Ukrainian elites of profiting from war as soldiers reported Starlink restrictions disrupting drone operations.

data.title: These Analysts Boost Their Forecasts On Ryder After Upbeat Q3 Results
data.description: Ryder beats Q3 estimates, raises FY2026 EPS guidance to $14.85-$15.05, and analysts lift price targets to $302-$315.
